verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own docs cover building branded invoices in a live-preview editor and sending them by email from Puzzle, so the create-and-send part of the story is delivered. Nothing in the pack shows online payment options or tracking of when an invoice is viewed or paid; the only related mention is that open invoices feed the cash forecast. Missing for 10: online payment options on invoices (pay links or card/ACH), viewed-status tracking, paid-status notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Puzzle's invoice editor lets you build a professional, branded invoice and see exactly how it will look as you go!
The editor opens in a split view: the form on the left, a live preview on the right that updates as you type — so you always know what your customer will see.
applies everywhere your invoice appears — the live preview, downloaded PDFs, and emails sent from Puzzle.
